verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents import capabilities (cURL import, OpenAPI import with tag-to-folder mapping) and organizes requests into collections/folders, supporting move-in scenarios, but the evidence pack has no explicit mention of exporting collections to Postman/OpenAPI or other portable formats for moving out to other tools. missing for 10: explicit export format documentation (e.g. Postman/OpenAPI export), independent hands-on verification of round-trip import/export.
